name: Amauri Sumika
source:
Second-year student. Swimming club member. Friend of Yuse.

She's cheerful, energetic, and loves festivals. She's not good at standing still. She's considerate of her friends, and when she sees someone in distress, she can't help but reach out to them. (Whether she can solve it or not is another matter.) Failure doesn't discourage her, and her passion for fun and all things cute is unmatched by anyone. She gets scared easily and is not good with horror. She also dislikes the cold. She wants to pursue a career in acting in the future.

She's proud of her large bust, describing her cup size as "melon cup." Although she's interested in naughty things, actually she has no sexual experience yet. As a result, she tends to blush and get flustered when the topic turns to that sort of thing. However, the thought of her breasts being ogled or fantasized about makes her feels proud.

She sees the protagonist, who's into naughty things and has his eye on someone else, as a convenient partner for sex practice.
